en.headline: Customs seizes 50kg silver ingots worth HK$1m at HZMB, driver charged
en.dek: A 30-year-old man was arrested after officers found the suspected smuggled silver hidden in the lower boot of an outgoing private car on 18 September.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it intercepted an outgoing private vehicle at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port on 18 September and seized about 50 kilograms of suspected smuggled silver ingots with an estimated market value of about HK$1 million.

Officers selected the vehicle for inspection based on risk assessment. The silver was found in the lower-deck storage compartment of the boot. A 30-year-old male driver was arrested and charged with one count of attempting to export unmanifested cargo. He is due to appear at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on 21 September.

Customs said it would continue to combat cross-boundary smuggling through risk assessment and intelligence analysis. Under the Import and Export Ordinance, anyone convicted of importing or exporting unmanifested cargo faces a maximum fine of HK$2 million and seven years' imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關港珠澳大橋截出境私家車 檢50公斤銀磚值百萬拘司機
zh.dek: 海關前日在港珠澳大橋香港口岸截查一輛出境私家車，於車尾箱下層置物格發現約50公斤懷疑走私銀磚，市值約100萬元，30歲男司機已被控。
body: 香港海關表示，前日（18日）根據風險評估，在港珠澳大橋香港口岸管制站截查一輛出境私家車，於車尾箱下層置物格發現約50公斤懷疑走私銀磚，估計市值約100萬元。
30歲男司機被捕，被控一項企圖輸出未列艙單貨物罪，案件將於9月21日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。海關指會繼續透過風險評估及情報分析嚴厲執法，打擊跨境走私活動。
根據《進出口條例》，任何人輸入或輸出未列艙單貨物，一經定罪，最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁7年。
